en: Dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor associated with pleasant feeling, there arises a state that is neither a root-cause nor associated with pleasant feeling, by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor associated with pleasant feeling, there arises a state that is not a non-root-cause and is not associated with pleasant feeling, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of root-cause condition (*hetu-paccaya*), there are nine [answers] … pe … in the case of non-disappearance condition (*avigata-paccaya*), there are nine. (In all cases, there are nine.

Dependent on a state that is not a root-cause (*na-hetu*) and not associated with painful feeling (*na-dukkhāya-vedanā-sampayutta*), a state that is not a root-cause and not associated with painful feeling arises by way of root-cause condition. (Abbreviated.
In the case of root-cause condition, there are nine … pe … in the case of non-disappearance condition, there are nine. (In all cases, there are nine.)

Dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, there arises a state that is neither a root-cause nor associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.
Nine in the case of root; ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance. (Nine in all cases.)
